title: WeakMap Cache
description:
Implement `weakCache(fn)` that memoizes the result of `fn` per object reference using a `WeakMap`, so results are cached without preventing garbage collection of the key objects.

**Example:**
```js
const compute = weakCache((obj) => obj.x * 2);
const a = { x: 5 };
compute(a); // 10 — computed
compute(a); // 10 — cached, fn not called again
```
ai_context: Common mistake: using a regular Map instead of WeakMap — this prevents garbage collection of keys. Also placing the cache outside the closure (sharing it across all calls to weakCache) instead of creating a new WeakMap per cached function.
